title: CPF Module Schema: Network watcher module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-networkwatcher'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

flow_log_name.description: (Required) The name of the Network Watcher Flow Log. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

flow_logs_enabled.description: (Optional) Should Network Flow Logging resource be deployed or skip as per input.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

network_security_group_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Network Security Group for which to enable flow logs for. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

retention_in_days.description: (Optional) The number of days to retain flow log records.

storage_account_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Storage Account where flow logs are stored.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

traffic_analytics.description: "(Required) Object for containing traffic analytics parameter" object({ workspace_id = "(Required) The resource GUID of the attached workspace." workspace_resource_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the attached workspace." })

flow_log_name.description: The Name of the created network watcher flow log

id.description: The ID of the created network watcher

name.description: The Name of the created network watcher

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Networkwatcher' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
